content:
dinesh: Heads-up — Quantor-13B (v1) will enter canary next Wed (traffic ramp to 5% -> 25% over 48h). Early perf numbers show ~2.1x tokens/sec on gen routes vs current quantized-7B.

leah: Do we have baseline numbers? what's current aggregate token/sec at peak?

kevin: Baseline peak observed last week: ~120k tokens/sec across serving fleet (all models). If Quantor ramps to full 25% customer traffic share, extrapolated peak tokens/sec -> ~252k (delta +132k).

maria: With our perf tests, an A100-equivalent slot for Quantor-13B handles ~9k tokens/sec steady with our runtime config (batching + KV). So delta implies ~15 additional A100 slots at peak. Add 30% cushion -> 20 slots.

dinesh: Quick cost/ops calc: 20 slots * 24h * 7d = 3360 GPU-hours/week. Provisioning lead time for extra Dedicated capacity in eu-west1 is 3–4 weeks; us-central has spare until Friday.

leah: EU constraint is a problem — several customers in EU. Can we do cross-region routing for canary? fallback to quantized-7B for eu users if capacity hits threshold?

kevin: Proposed rollout plan: 5% global canary, monitor latency/cost for 24h; if token/sec growth > +40% vs baseline or p95 latency > 300ms, auto-failover to quantized variant. I wired this into the routing policy.

ops-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary policy created: policy-id q13b-canary-2026-03. Fallback route -> quantor-13b-q4 (quantized) ; throttle policy = 200r/s per shard.

maria: Also need autoscaler tuning: bump max_replicas from 120 -> 160 for serving-pool-13b, and set permissive burst to +10% for 2 hours after deployment. I'll open infra ticket.

dinesh: Ticket created: INF-4021 — 'Quantor canary provisioning + autoscaler tweaks' (link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-4021). Owners: maria, kevin. Target: provision cross-region routing and update dashboards by Tue.

leah: One more ask: update cost forecast spreadsheet. If full launch (100%) effect, we estimate ~13k GPU-hours/week and ~+22% infra cost. I'll update sheet and ping finance.

kevin: TL;DR action items: (1) Maria adjust autoscaler + open infra PR, (2) Dinesh set canary schedule and monitor dashboards, (3) Leah update cost forecast, (4) Ops fallback ready. Re-check Friday for eu capacity.

maria: ack. I'll put a slack invite for a 15m sync Fri 10:30am.

leah: :thumbsup:
